description: This file contains driver implementation for the Microchip XEC PS2 interface in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, initialization, interrupt handling, power management, and register access functions.

methods.name: ps2_xec_configure
methods.description: Configures the PS2 device with a callback ISR, clears status, and enables interrupts.

methods.name: ps2_xec_write
methods.description: Writes a byte to the PS2 device, handling synchronization and timeout.

methods.name: ps2_xec_inhibit_interface
methods.description: Disables the PS2 interface and clears relevant interrupts.

methods.name: ps2_xec_enable_interface
methods.description: Enables the PS2 interface and clears relevant interrupts.

methods.name: ps2_xec_init
methods.description: Initializes the PS2 driver, applies pinctrl, clears sleep enable, initializes semaphore, and configures IRQ.
